description: Legal record (#119) in a court register/pinqas from a Karaite beit din in Cairo (on f. 39r of Yevr.-Arab. I 328). Location: Cairo. Dated: Av 5327 AM (1567 CE). Damaged lease agreement, probably for a property held within the pious endowment of the Karaite community of Cairo based on the formula of the preceding entry. Most of the key details are lost to damage. This page from the court register is torn and detached along the edge where it would have once been bound. Surprisingly it dates to the same month and year as the entry preceding it (#118) despite the fact that 4 pages were cut from the binding after folio 38. MCD.
description_he: מסמך משפטי ביהודית-ערבית. מוחזק בהספרייה הלאומית רוסיה.
